title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.hpp implements a four-component 2-D compressible ideal-gas state, Rusanov and Newtonian/Fourier fluxes.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: MeshCGNS.cpp:109–150,185–207 reads separate TRI/QUAD/BAR sections and all zones of first base; MIXED sections are skipped.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:41–101 distributes face flux to owned left/right cells with opposite signs; :105–158 handles wall and farfield fluxes.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Physics.hpp implements local Lax–Friedrichs/Rusanov; no independent high-order Riemann solver credit is inferred.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Residual.cpp:105–158 uses farfield, slip and no-slip paths, projecting wall temperature gradient to enforce adiabatic condition; OutputWriter.cpp:184–199 writes boundary wall state.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Gradient.cpp:31–46,120–125 computes/exchanges Green–Gauss gradients; Residual.cpp:48–59 reconstructs both sides and falls back if nonphysical. Ghost limiter exchange is absent.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Reconstruction.hpp:96–106 initializes all factors to one, :137–158 updates only owned cells; Residual.cpp:48–53 uses ghost factors in face reconstruction without exchange. Venkat limiting exists on owned cells.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Residual.cpp:77–88 averages gradients without the face-joining correction claimed in report.tex:112; :242–263 integrates full traction, while surface cf is tangential. Newtonian/Fourier flux exists.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Solver.cpp uses LU-SGS pseudo-time and residual checks; M015 max-step plateau is falsely successful despite oscillating force.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Solver.cpp:71–110 freezes history and tests spatial plus BDF physical residual. Selected metadata reports zero misses, but git revision null prevents exact binary attribution; t300.01/30001 and FFT≈0.160 are limitations.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:66–71 deletes root global mesh before solve; METIS/neighbor halo exist. Report np2/np8 force comparison conflicts with selected np8 and np2 raw package unlocated.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
